metadata.question: Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and  2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and 2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?" We need to: 1. Define a region for Asir, Saudi Arabia (use a polygon covering the region) 2. Calculate NDVI for June 2016 and June 2017 3. Calculate the long-term average NDVI for June over 2003-2011 4. Compare: if both 2016 and 2017 NDVI > long-term average, answer Yes (A), else No (B) 5. Handle data availability issues (C1, C2, C3, D) Strategy: - Use MODIS MOD13Q1 (250m, 16-day NDVI) which provides NDVI directly with QA band - For each year, filter June images (month=6), take median, mask using QA band - Compute mean NDVI over the region for each year - For long-term average: compute mean of June NDVI for years 2003-2011 - Compare 2016 and 2017 with this average Data quality: - Check collection size for each year (if 0, try to recover? MODIS should have data) - Check valid pixel count after masking - Validate NDVI values (should be between -1 and 1) Geometry: Asir region in Saudi Arabia. Use approximate coordinates. Asir region coordinates: approximately 18.0°N to 20.0°N, 42.0°E to 44.0°E We'll use a polygon: ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [42.0, 18.0], [44.0, 18.0], [44.0, 20.0], [42.0, 20.0], [42.0, 18.0] ]) Time periods: - Long-term: June of each year 2003-2011 (inclusive) - Comparison: June 2016 and June 2017 Approach: 1. Function to get June NDVI for a given year - Filter MOD13Q1 for June 1-30 of that year - Mask using 'SummaryQA' band (keep only value 0 = good data) - Take median of June images - Compute mean NDVI over region - Return mean NDVI and valid pixel count 2. For each year 2003-2011, get June NDVI, store in array 3. Compute long-term average as mean of these values 4. Get June NDVI for 2016 and 2017 5. Compare: if 2016 > avg AND 2017 > avg, then Yes, else No Data checks: - If any collection has 0 images, output C1 - If after masking, valid pixel count is 0, output C2 - If NDVI values are None/NaN or outside [-1,1], output C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Asir, Saudi Arabia const asirRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [42.0, 18.0], [44.0, 18.0], [44.0, 20.0], [42.0, 20.0], [42.0, 18.0] ]); // 2. Function to get June NDVI for a specific year function getJuneNDVI(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 5, 1); // June 1 (month is 0-based) const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 5, 30); // June 30 // Load MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI collection const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(asirRegion); // Check collection size const colSize = col.size(); // Mask low quality pixels (SummaryQA = 0 means good data) const maskedCol = col.map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('SummaryQA'); const mask = qa.eq(0); // Keep only good quality pixels const ndvi = img.select('NDVI') .updateMask(mask) .multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor for MOD13Q1 NDVI return ndvi.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); }); // Take median of June images const medianImg = maskedCol.median(); return { collection: col, maskedCollection: maskedCol, image: medianImg, size: colSize }; } // 3. Get long-term NDVI (2003-2011) const longTermYears = []; const longTermNDVIs = []; for (let year = 2003; year <= 2011; year++) { const result = getJuneNDVI(year); const colSize = result.size.getInfo(); console.log(`${year} June Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log(`No images for ${year}, skipping`); continue; } // Compute mean NDVI and pixel count const stats = result.image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: asirRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNdvi = stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} NDVI: ${meanNdvi ? meanNdvi.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // Check for valid data if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year}, skipping`); continue; } if (meanNdvi === null || meanNdvi === undefined || isNaN(meanNdvi)) { console.log(`Invalid NDVI value for ${year}, skipping`); continue; } // Validate NDVI range if (meanNdvi < -1 || meanNdvi > 1) { console.log(`NDVI out of range for ${year}: ${meanNdvi}, skipping`); continue; } longTermYears.push(year); longTermNDVIs.push(meanNdvi); } // 4. Check if we have any long-term data if (longTermYears.length === 0) { console.log("No valid long-term data (2003-2011)"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate long-term average const longTermAvg = longTermNDVIs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / longTermNDVIs.length; console.log(`Long-term average NDVI (${longTermYears.length} years): ${longTermAvg.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Get 2016 and 2017 NDVI const yearsToCheck = [2016, 2017]; const recentNDVIs = []; for (const year of yearsToCheck) { const result = getJuneNDVI(year); const colSize = result.size.getInfo(); console.log(`${year} June Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log(`No images for ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Compute mean NDVI and pixel count const stats = result.image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: asirRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNdvi = stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} NDVI: ${meanNdvi ? meanNdvi.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // Check for valid data if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year}`); console.log("C2"); return; } if (meanNdvi === null || meanNdvi === undefined || isNaN(meanNdvi)) { console.log(`Invalid NDVI value for ${year}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Validate NDVI range if (meanNdvi < -1 || meanNdvi > 1) { console.log(`NDVI out of range for ${year}: ${meanNdvi}`); console.log("C3"); return; } recentNDVIs.push(meanNdvi); } // 6. Compare recent years with long-term average console.log(`2016 NDVI: ${recentNDVIs[0].toFixed(4)} vs Long-term: ${longTermAvg.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`2017 NDVI: ${recentNDVIs[1].toFixed(4)} vs Long-term: ${longTermAvg.toFixed(4)}`); const bothHigher = recentNDVIs[0] > longTermAvg && recentNDVIs[1] > longTermAvg; // 7. Output final answer if (bothHigher) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
